title: Existence of augmentation-normalized additive etale Cech edges
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U a finite open cover whose intersections indexed by every positive-length tuple are affine. For every n≥0 there exists an additive equivalence from H^n of the fixed lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction] to the homology of the ordinary unit cechOver complex [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change], satisfying the augmentation normalization [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. There are no coefficient endomorphisms or morphisms between schemes in this assertion.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine-cover proof; Tag 01EQ, augmentation construction; Tag 01FD, Lemma 20.15.1, commuting augmented double-complex diagram. Worker-written explicit normalization of this argument.

proof.text: For a fixed injective resolution J obtain a canonical global comparison cJ. The augmentation homology lemma provides the actual global-to-total and ordinary-Cech-to-total additive equivalences p and q with their cycle formulas. Define a=q inverse composed with p and cJ inverse.

For any other resolution I and supplied canonical comparison cI, transfer its global and total cycles to J using the identity lift. The alpha and beta squares give the corresponding cycle representatives in J, and homology-map naturality transfers the equality of their total classes. The canonical transfer equation identifies cI with cJ on the transferred class. Apply the two augmentation formulas on J and q inverse to obtain the required normalization. No invertibility of the total transfer is needed.

proof_origin.place: Identity-resolution transfer followed by the two augmentation homology maps; affine vanishing as in Tag 03P2.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleAdditiveCech_normalized
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : Sheaf.H X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
      (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n,
      IsEtaleAdditiveCechNormalized U n a
